tcg-advanced.name: TCG Advanced
tcg-advanced.description: Official TCG tournament format: standard deck sizes, at most 3 copies per card and the current TCG Forbidden & Limited List.

ocg.name: OCG
ocg.description: Japanese tournament format: standard deck sizes, at most 3 copies per card and the OCG Forbidden & Limited List.

goat.name: GOAT Format
goat.description: Retro format as of April 2005: only cards released in the TCG up to June 2005, plus the GOAT banlist.

edison.name: Edison
edison.description: Retro format as of April 2010 (SJC Edison): only TCG cards released up to Duelist Pack: Kaiba (The Shining Darkness is not legal), plus the TCG Forbidden & Limited List of March 2010. The later Hidden Arsenal reprints of older cards are not modeled.
edison.cutoffLabel: Only cards up to Duelist Pack: Kaiba (April 2010)

classic-plus.name: Classic Plus
classic-plus.cutoffLabel: Rule 1: Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum and Link monsters
classic-plus.description: House format on the 2005 field (no Extra Monster Zones or Pendulum Zones, one shared Field Zone; the first player does not draw): Main Deck 40–50, Extra Deck up to 10, no Side Deck. No Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum or Link; floodgates, hand traps, draw, burn, revival, mass removal, protection and negation are forbidden or limited by the Classic Plus rules. Everything else is playable at 3.

unlimited.name: No banlist
unlimited.description: Standard deck sizes and at most 3 copies per card, but no Forbidden & Limited List at all.

handtrap.question: What counts as a hand trap?
handtrap.open: Until you choose, the hand trap rule is not applied.

classic-plus.label: Classic Plus definition
classic-plus.definition: A hand trap is a monster effect that can be activated from the hand during the opponent's turn. It is forbidden if it negates or prevents an action of the opponent or removes a card from any zone (except this card itself). Effects that work only in the Battle Phase or against battle damage are allowed. Implemented as a fixed list of cards.

restrictive.label: More restrictive
restrictive.definition: Every monster whose text says it can be played from the hand outside your own Main Phase: discard the card, send it from the hand, or summon it as a Quick Effect, in the opponent's turn, in the Battle Phase or in response. Whatever the effect does. The list is built from the card text and may contain a card too many or miss one.

own.label: My own definition
own.definition: You decide what a hand trap is. Write the definition into your rulebook (PDF or text) and upload it again.

sleeves.why: Sleeves are seen at the table, not in the deck. The app doesn't know them and can't check them.

effect_class.text: Rule “{topic}”: cards are restricted by what they do
effect_class.why: Which cards count depends on the effect, and the app deliberately doesn't read effects. Name the affected cards one by one (“Individual cards”) or use a ready-made list.

banlist_unknown.text: A banlist applies, but the text doesn't say which
banlist_unknown.why: The app knows TCG, OCG, GOAT, Edison and Classic Plus. Pick the right one as a “Banlist” rule in the editor, or add the cards one by one.

card_names_missing.text: {count} card not found in the catalog: {names} | {count} cards not found in the catalog: {names}
card_names_missing.why: The name doesn't match a single card clearly (typo or a different name). Add the cards by hand under “Individual cards” in the editor.

rule_invalid.text: A rule ({kind}) didn't pass the check
rule_invalid.why: Its values contradict each other or are outside what the app allows. The rule was left out.

too_many_rules.why: A format can have at most {max} rules. The rest was left out.

not_understood.why: The sentence matches no rule the app knows. If it contains a deck rule, add it by hand in the editor.
